### Observed differences

- In the later window, the elapsed time between the completion of A01 and A03 dropped from a mean of about 0.84 hours to about 0.42 hours, roughly half. The median and quartiles also fell by similar amounts (e.g., median from about 0.83 to 0.42 hours). The number of observed gaps was similar (34 before, 35 after). [TWAIT001]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports a hypothesis that the time between the completion of A01 and A03 shortened in the later window. The decrease is large and consistent across the mean, median, and quartiles, and the empirical strength is very high (0.9995). The single time-family item far exceeds the chance expectation (1 item vs. 0.009 expected), so it is unlikely to be a random split artefact. The main limitation is that this rests on one indicator and a moderate number of traces (about 17% of cases in each window), and TWAIT reflects elapsed time between consecutive completions, so we cannot separate waiting from processing time. No other differences were observed.
